attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count combines per-frame overhead, spatial work with different costs for first and subsequent frames, and quadratic spatial attention work.

pcvs.name: latent_frames
pcvs.rationale: Tracks decoder invocations and per-frame Python and operator overhead.

pcvs.name: first_frame_area
pcvs.rationale: Tracks spatial work for the first decoded frame, whose temporal expansion differs from later frames.

pcvs.name: subsequent_frame_area
pcvs.rationale: Tracks convolution, normalization, and copying work for subsequent frames with temporal upsampling and populated caches.

pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Tracks quadratic spatial attention work in the decoder middle block.
